question: Which of the following is observed on the birthday of Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Teacher's Day**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Teacher's Day in India is celebrated on **5th September** every year to commemorate the birth anniversary of Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan.
 
• Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan was the **second President of India** (1962-1967) and a renowned philosopher, teacher, and scholar.
